_README: Edit this file to change any OTT homepage with NO app update. Top-level keys are the providers: Netflix, Prime, DisneyPlus, Hotstar. Under each, add rows in customRows: [{ title, ids[], provider? }]. provider picks the poster CDN (defaults to that section's provider). Use ids from THAT provider (Netflix/Prime ids differ). top10 / top10Series / top10Movies / newThisWeek are optional overrides; omit to keep the automatic ones. Users get changes on next launch (1h cache).
